NONE: › (of rocks) formed from magma (= very hot liquid rock that has cooled)

I or T: › [ I or T ] formal to (cause to) start burning or explode
T: › [ T ] to cause a dangerous, excited, or angry situation to begin

example: The fuel spontaneously ignites because of the high temperature and pressure.
燃料因高溫和高壓而自燃。
The proposed restrictions have ignited a storm of protest.
擬議中的限制規定激起了抗議的浪潮。

C usually singular: › [ C usually singular ] the electrical system in an engine that causes the fuel to burn or explode in order to start the engine
U: › [ U ] formal the act or process of something starting to burn

example: Switch/Turn the ignition on.
打開點火開關。
an ignition key
點火開關

NONE: › morally bad and making you feel ashamed

example: an ignoble action/idea
卑鄙的行為／想法

NONE: › (especially of events or behaviour) embarrassing because of being a complete failure
（尤指事件或行為）恥辱的，丟臉的

example: an ignominious defeat/failure/retreat
聲譽掃地的落敗／可恥的失敗／恥辱的撤退
The incumbent party experienced the ignominy of total defeat in the last election.
執政黨在上次選舉中蒙受了大敗的恥辱。
I'm a complete ignoramus where computers are concerned.
在電腦方面，我完全是個門外漢。

NONE: C2 lack of knowledge, understanding, or information about something

example: Public ignorance about the disease is still a cause for concern.
公眾對這個疾病的無知仍是一個令人擔憂的問題。
Patients, it is claimed, were kept/left in ignorance of what was wrong with them.
據稱，病人被蒙在鼓裡，對於自己得了甚麼病還毫不知情。

NONE: › said to emphasize that sometimes it is better for you if you do not know all the facts about a situation
C2 not having enough knowledge, understanding, or information about something
› UK informal not polite or showing respect

example: Many teenagers are surprisingly ignorant about current politics.
許多青少年對時事政治無知得讓人吃驚。
We remained blissfully ignorant of the troubles that lay ahead.
我們對將要出現的麻煩一無所知，這或許是一種幸運。
Ignorant lout!
沒禮貌的混蛋！

NONE: B2 to intentionally not listen or give attention to

example: She can be really irritating but I try to ignore her.
她有時會特別煩人，不過我盡量不去理會她。
Safety regulations are being ignored by company managers in the drive to increase profits.
為了增加利潤，公司經理都對安全章程熟視無睹。
How can the government ignore the wishes of the majority?
政府怎麼能不顧大多數人的意願呢？
I smiled at her but she just ignored me.
我對她笑了笑，可她根本沒理睬我。
